definitions.explanation: A unit of measurement used in cooking, equal to 5 milliliters. Also refers to the small spoon itself used for measuring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧{小|こ}さじ1⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{小|こ}さじ2⟦{杯|はい}→杯：00933_hai⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put in two teaspoons of sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、しょうゆ{小|こ}さじ1⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{酢|す}→酢：01057_su⟧{小|こ}さじ2⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜ{合|あ}わせます→混ぜ合わせる：27842_mazeawaseru⟧。
examples.english: In this recipe, mix together one teaspoon of soy sauce and two teaspoons of vinegar.

notes:
{小|こ}さじ is a standard cooking measurement equal to 5 ml (one teaspoon). It is one of the two fundamental measuring spoon sizes in Japanese cooking.

MEASUREMENT PAIR:
- {小|こ}さじ: teaspoon (5 ml)
- ⟦{大|おお}さじ→大さじ：22527_oosaji⟧: tablespoon (15 ml) — three times a {小|こ}さじ

RECIPE NOTATION:
In recipes, the amount follows directly after the ingredient:
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧{小|こ}さじ1: one teaspoon of salt
- ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧{小|こ}さじ2: two teaspoons of sugar

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {小|こ}さじ⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧: half a teaspoon
- {小|こ}さじ⟦{山盛|やまも}り→山盛り：10157_yamamori⟧: a heaped teaspoon
- {小|こ}さじ{摺|す}り{切|き}り: a level teaspoon

FORMS:
⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) + さじ (spoon). さじ is from the Portuguese word for spoon. The kanji form is ⟦{匙|さじ}→匙：03886_saji⟧.
